title: Settings
preferencesPrivate: Only you see these. They follow you to any device.

family.title: Family Settings
family.shared: Shared by everyone in your Family. Any member can change them.
family.staleThresholdHelp: A batch counts as expiring soon this many days before it expires.
family.overridesHelp: Used to pre-fill the expiry date when you add a batch. They replace the Catalog defaults.
family.noOverrides: No overrides yet. Catalog defaults are used.
